name: @robosystems/content-renderer
description: Playwright-based local renderer for the content machine. `capture`: drive the live RoboLedger UI (headless login → named scenes) → stills/clips for the showcase demo. `motion`: render an HTML composition (the video templates, the brand film's type layer) frame by frame → mp4. Reads the brand tokens, fonts and logos in design-system/; audio (VO/music) stays in the Python pipeline.
